title: Google Business Profile Photo Click-Through Rate
takeaway: Businesses with photos receive approximately 40% more clicks from Google Maps searches.

data.label: Businesses with Photos
data.evidence: A study has shown that businesses with photos receive approximately 40% more clicks from Google Maps searches.

narration: Google prioritizes businesses with complete and engaging profiles, and a profile brimming with relevant photos signals to the search engine that you’re an active, trustworthy, and legitimate business. This visual strategy directly impacts your online performance, boosting your ranking and driving more customers.
